injected_env_vars.name: TUNNEL_FQDN
injected_env_vars.description: Fully-qualified domain name of the Cloudflare tunnel subdomain (e.g. planet.scareverse.net). Used by nginx to set server_name and route traffic.

injected_env_vars.name: VITE_SERVICE_NAME
injected_env_vars.description: Docker service name for the Vite frontend upstream (e.g. vite). Read from config.vite.service_name.

injected_env_vars.name: BACKEND_SERVICE_NAME
injected_env_vars.description: Docker service name for the backend API upstream (e.g. backend). Read from config.backend.service_name.
